US Envoys Visit Moscow for Russia-Ukraine Peace Talks

US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow to push for peace talks between Russia and Ukraine. They are expected to meet with Russian officials before traveling to Kyiv. This visit aims to revive stalled negotiations for an end to the conflict. Russia reportedly conducted airstrikes on Ukrainian airports ahead of the envoys' arrival. The envoys are carrying a new plan from the US to end the war.
